title: Closed downtown San Francisco Centre mall could be turned into an AI data center, according to proposal from K-G Growth Partners
hook_text: San Francisco mall eyed for AI
script:
San Francisco Centre mall could host a massive AI experience. K-G Growth Partners is pitching this plan to city officials.
The investment firm wants to transform the dormant space into a center for interactive AI exhibits.
The project intends to showcase advanced technology to the public rather than housing heavy server hardware.
K-G Growth Partners has started preliminary discussions with officials regarding potential permits for this concept.
The mall has sat largely empty since major retailers left the downtown shopping hub.
This proposal aims to bring foot traffic back to the struggling Market Street corridor.
Would you visit an AI-themed attraction in a mall?
